question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Paragon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Epitome**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Paragon **means a perfect example of something or someone. (किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति का एक आदर्श उदाहरण)

 
 
• **Example**: *She is a paragon of beauty and grace.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Epitome **means a perfect example of a particular quality or type. (किसी विशेष गुणवत्ता या प्रकार
